rules.quote: Create complete reports with a landing page, preliminary content, body and endmatter.
rules.violation_condition: a report missing a landing page, preliminary content, body or endmatter
rules.why: General instruction on mandatory report components.

rules.quote: HTML should be the default format for all government information.
rules.violation_condition: government information published without an HTML version as the default
rules.why: Establishes HTML as the default format.

rules.quote: You should also make sure the content is available in another format, such as HTML.
rules.violation_condition: a PDF or printed report that is not available in an alternative accessible format such as HTML
when: when publishing a PDF or printed report
rules.why: Requires an alternative format alongside PDF or print versions.

rules.quote: Electronic versions must be identical to printed versions and must be accessible.
rules.violation_condition: an electronic version of a printed document that differs from the print version or is not accessible
rules.why: Mandates parity between print and electronic versions.

covers.quote: name of the author or editor.

rules.quote: The landing page or cover also shows the:
rules.violation_condition: a landing page or cover that is missing the title, subtitle (if applicable) or the name of the author or editor
rules.why: Consolidates the list of elements a landing page or cover must display.

rules.quote: If more than about 5 millimetres wide, the spine shows the title, author and publisher’s logo. The words always run across or down the spine.
rules.violation_condition: a spine wider than 5mm that lacks the title, author, or publisher's logo, or has text running in an unapproved direction
when: the spine is more than about 5 millimetres wide
rules.why: Explicit requirements for spine formatting on printed documents.

rules.quote: Australian Government reports published online should include the same information as a printed version.
rules.violation_condition: an online report that excludes information present in the printed version
rules.why: Requires content parity for reports between formats.

covers.quote: name of the sponsor, if applicable.

rules.quote: A title page should include the following:
rules.violation_condition: a title page missing the title, subtitle, author's name, or sponsor's name
rules.why: Consolidates the mandatory components of a title page.

covers.quote: Show the main title exactly as it appears on the cover.
Include a series title if the report is part of a series.

rules.quote: Conventions for a half-title page are:
rules.violation_condition: a half-title page that modifies the main title, displays subtitles, or omits a series title for a report in a series
when: producing a half-title page
rules.why: Groups the conventions required for formatting half-title pages.

rules.quote: Number them with lower case roman numerals such as ’i’, ’ii’, ’iii’ and ’iv’.
rules.violation_condition: preliminary pages numbered using arabic numerals or upper case roman numerals
when: numbering preliminary pages
rules.why: Direct rule for numbering styles on preliminary pages.

covers.quote: the signature of the person responsible for the report
the day, month and year the report was submitted.

rules.quote: The letter of transmittal must include the purpose of the report and who it is for. It must have:
rules.violation_condition: a letter of transmittal that does not include the report's purpose, its audience, the signature of the responsible person, or the date of submission
when: including a letter of transmittal
rules.why: Consolidates all content requirements for letters of transmittal.

rules.quote: Use the heading ‘Contents’, not ‘Table of contents’ or ‘List of contents’.
rules.violation_condition: using 'Table of contents' or 'List of contents' as the heading
rules.why: States a clear preference against specific alternate headings.

rules.quote: Give each image a page number in the list.
rules.violation_condition: an image listed in a list of images that lacks a page number
rules.why: Requires page numbering in image lists.

rules.quote: The order of lists is:
rules.violation_condition: lists of images and tables ordered differently than photographs, figures, maps, then tables
when: using multiple lists of images and tables
rules.why: Specifies the precise sequence for ordering various list types.

rules.quote: Don't use ‘Executive summary’.
rules.violation_condition: the phrase 'Executive summary' used as a heading
rules.why: Advises against specific discouraged phrasing for summary sections.

rules.quote: Both chapters and parts need short titles that tell the user what is in the content.
rules.violation_condition: chapters or parts lacking short descriptive titles
rules.why: Requires titles for structural report elements.

rules.quote: Use consecutive numbering for chapter titles through the report. If the report contains parts, continue the chapter numbering into each part.
rules.violation_condition: chapter numbering that restarts at the beginning of a new part rather than continuing consecutively
rules.why: Prevents restarting chapter numbers unnecessarily across parts.

rules.quote: Don't use roman numerals to number parts.
rules.violation_condition: roman numerals used to number report parts
rules.why: Clear instruction avoiding specific numerical formats.

rules.quote: It is better to start chapters and parts on a right-hand page, particularly the first chapter and part. Also follow this approach for PDF reports.
rules.violation_condition: chapters or parts starting on a left-hand page in a print or PDF layout
rules.why: Extracts the formatting rule about page placement for part structures.

rules.quote: Page numbering for the endmatter continues from the main body of the report.
rules.violation_condition: page numbering that restarts at the beginning of the endmatter
rules.why: Specifies continuous numbering across body and endmatter.

rules.quote: Number appendices differently from how chapters are numbered in the report.
rules.violation_condition: appendices numbered using the identical numbering style as chapters
rules.why: Ensures visual distinction between chapter and appendix references.

rules.quote: If there are several appendices, use a title page. List the title of each appendix on the title page.
rules.specification: Several is ambiguously defined, standardise to '2 or more'.
rules.violation_condition: a report with several appendices that lacks a title page listing their titles
when: there are several appendices
rules.why: Instructs writers to include an overview title page for multiple appendices.

rules.quote: If the list is brief, include it in the preliminary content.
rules.violation_condition: a brief list of shortened forms not placed in the preliminary content
when: a list of shortened forms is brief
rules.why: Provides placement instruction for short abbreviation lists.

rules.quote: Do not incorporate the list of shortened forms in the glossary.
rules.violation_condition: a list of shortened forms that is incorporated directly into the glossary
rules.why: Strict instruction keeping two distinct list types separated.

rules.quote: Don’t use a glossary if there is a small number of terms to explain.
rules.specification: Threshold needed for 'small number', e.g. fewer than 5 items.
rules.violation_condition: a glossary created to explain only a small number of terms, instead of explaining them in the text
rules.why: Prevents over-structuring with glossaries when few terms need definition.

rules.quote: List glossary items in alphabetical order.
rules.violation_condition: glossary terms sorted in an order other than alphabetical
rules.why: Alphabetical sorting requirement for glossaries.

rules.quote: Always place a bibliography after a reference list or endnotes if the report has both.
rules.violation_condition: a bibliography placed before a reference list or endnotes section
when: the report has both a bibliography and a reference list or endnotes
rules.why: Sets a strict sequence order for reference types.

rules.quote: Each volume should have a summary list of the contents of the other volumes in the set.
rules.violation_condition: a volume in a multi-volume set that lacks a summary list of the other volumes' contents
when: publishing a multi-volume report
rules.why: Ensures cross-referencing capabilities across multi-volume materials.

covers.quote: When the break is in the main body of the text, continue the numbering across volumes.
When the break is for different material (for example, endmatter), number each volume in a separate way.

rules.quote: Number the pages according to the break in the volumes:
rules.violation_condition: page numbering restarting within the main body across volumes, or incorrectly continuing across volumes when the break separates distinct material types
when: numbering pages in a multi-volume report
rules.why: Consolidates rules on handling page number continuity across document volumes.

rules.quote: Always number preliminary pages per volume.
rules.violation_condition: preliminary pages that are numbered sequentially across different volumes, instead of restarting per volume
when: a report is split into multiple volumes
rules.why: Mandates that preliminary numbering restarts for every new volume.

rules.quote: Where numbering restarts for each volume, references should include both the volume and page number. Where the numbering continues across volumes, use just the page number for the reference.
rules.violation_condition: a reference that lacks a volume number when page numbering restarts, or includes a volume number when continuous numbering makes it unnecessary
when: referencing across a multi-volume report
rules.why: Governs referencing formats specifically for multi-volume breaks.
